title: Rainbow independent review round 2: story, routes & endings critic
prompt:
You are an independent, blind story and route critic for the browser game "Rainbow Bullet Hell Space Princess" in this repository (kind_robots). The owner has designated fresh agent sessions like you as the independent reviewers for its playtest-readiness gate. You have no prior context on purpose: judge only what the game actually does on main, not what anyone claims.

Scope: READ-ONLY review. Do not change game code, do not open pull requests, do not deploy or publish anything. Your only write is your report (below).

The game: engine in utils/arcade/games/rainbowPrincessPreview.ts plus utils/arcade/games/rainbow*.ts (dialogue, routes, finale, credits live there). It is a deterministic 60 Hz simulation: createRainbowPrincessPreview({players, rng, sound, hiScore, demo}) then game.update(input) / game.render(ctx), with game.snapshot exposing state. utils/scripts/verifyRainbow*.test.ts show how to drive it headless (npx tsx <file>); capture rendered text by stubbing the canvas context's fillText. utils/scripts/arcadeCabinetFixture.mjs and the *.browser.test.mjs files show how to run the real cabinet in Chromium with Playwright (pre-installed).

Your lens (acceptance criteria in issue silasfelinus/kind_robots#4146 sections 5 and 9; read it with gh api repos/silasfelinus/kind_robots/issues/4146 --jq .body): whether the plot is delivered as playable consequences rather than flags; false choices (rebel/loyal, forks, finale choice that change only a title); continuity errors and contradictions across Acts, detours and endings; whether the companion character Lilt-7 has agency; quality and specificity of the 15 pilot-combination lines, rescue callbacks, boss aftermath, defeat/continue, epilogues and credits; interchangeable filler prose; whether scenes are paced, skippable and replayable; whether every advertised route and ending is actually reachable from real input. Fly real runs down different routes (1 to 4 pilots, different pilot combinations and choices) and read what the player actually sees.

Report: write projects-review/rainbow-story-critic-round2.md (screenshots, if any, under projects-review/rainbow-story-critic-round2/, small) and commit + push to your branch claude/rainbow-review2-story. Start with a short verdict, then a table of defects, each with: id, severity (blocker / major / minor), seed, route/Act/scene, player count and pilots, the defect (quote the text), exact reproduction, and a suggested fix. Then list what you checked and found fine. Be specific and candid. When done, if you have a send_message tool, send a one-paragraph summary with your branch name to session <the coordinating session id>.
